description: Provides bidirectional document conversion between HTML, [tp-asciidoc](http://127.0.0.1:4323/), [tp-latex](http://127.0.0.1:4325/), [tp-markdown](http://127.0.0.1:4322/) and [tp-restructuredtext](http://127.0.0.1:4324/), with editable code and rendered previews.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-markup-converter><script type="tp/markdown">
# Workshop

A **practical** introduction to markup.

| Formula | Image |
| :--- | :--- |
| :tp-math:`E = mc^2`{mode="latexmath"} | ![Canoe](/medias/image/canoe.svg){width=160} |
[Science and illustration]
</script></tp-markup-converter>

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Source language; aliases adoc, tex, md and rst are accepted.

attributes.name: show-code
attributes.description: Initially displays code and rendered output together in every language viewer.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Source file URL; takes precedence over value and its extension determines the language.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Source text; takes precedence over inline script content.

methods.name: convert(language: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Converts edited code into all five formats without replacing the active editor.

methods.name: getMarkup(language?: string): Promise<string>
methods.description: Returns the source for a target language after the current conversion finishes.

methods.name: importFile(file: File): Promise<void>
methods.description: Loads a markup file as the new source document.

methods.name: openImport(language: string): void
methods.description: Opens the source-file chooser with the requested markup format filter.

methods.name: resetDocument(): void
methods.description: Restores the initially loaded source and updates all conversions.

methods.name: save(language: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Saves the current conversion in the requested language.

methods.name: setSource(value: string, language: string): void
methods.description: Replaces the source and selects its language tab.

events.name: tp-markup-converter-change
events.description: Emitted after a source document has been loaded and converted.

events.name: tp-markup-converter-error
events.description: Emitted when loading, conversion or saving fails.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-markup-converter>` element provides bidirectional document conversion between HTML, [tp-asciidoc](http://127.0.0.1:4323/), [tp-latex](http://127.0.0.1:4325/), [tp-markdown](http://127.0.0.1:4322/) and [tp-restructuredtext](http://127.0.0.1:4324/), with editable code and rendered previews.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Files → Import → format | Choose a source file; its extension determines the language and selects its tab. |
| Files → Export as → format | Choose a filename and save the document in that format. |
| Language tabs | Compare the five source formats. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen-exit" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="theme-light-dark" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="palette-swatch" size="2em"} Color / Theme / Fullscreen | Change the converter appearance or open it fullscreen. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file" size="2em"} Files | Import a document or save it in another markup format. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls. |
| <kbd>Left</kbd> / <kbd>Right</kbd> | Move between focused tabs. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused control. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the Files menu. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component in the hierarchy and open its help. |
